requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online anytime, selecting services and preferred barbers.
The system must send automated SMS and email reminders 24 hours and one hour before appointments, containing essential appointment details.
Barbers should be able to manage their own schedules, including setting availability, requesting time off, indicating breaks, and receiving notifications for changes.
Daily and weekly summaries should provide insights into total bookings, cancellations, peak times, service breakdowns, barber performance, customer insights, and a financial overview.
The system must be user-friendly, ensuring ease of use for both customers and barbers, while remaining budget-conscious for the business.
The system must comply with GDPR for customer data storage.
Booking interface must be usable on mobile devices.
